import bpy, math, os
from mathutils import Vector

# ---- clean scene ----
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for coll in (bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.curves, bpy.data.materials, bpy.data.cameras, bpy.data.lights):
    pass

def mat(name, color, rough=0.3, metallic=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name)
    if m: return m
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if 'Specular IOR Level' in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value = 0.5
    return m

YEL = mat('YellowPlastic', (1.0, 0.79, 0.04), 0.22)
YEL2 = mat('YellowDark', (0.85, 0.62, 0.02), 0.35)
BLK = mat('BlackPlastic', (0.012, 0.012, 0.014), 0.32)
BLK2 = mat('BlackMatte', (0.03, 0.03, 0.03), 0.5)
WHT = mat('White', (0.96, 0.96, 0.95), 0.35)
EYEW = mat('EyeWhite', (0.92, 0.90, 0.86), 0.18)
PUP = mat('Pupil', (0.005, 0.005, 0.005), 0.15)
RIM = mat('EyeRim', (0.32, 0.26, 0.20), 0.35, 0.65)
GREY = mat('Grey', (0.45,0.45,0.45), 0.5)

def assign(obj, material):
    if obj and material:
        if obj.data and hasattr(obj.data, 'materials'):
            obj.data.materials.clear()
            obj.data.materials.append(material)
    return obj

def smooth(obj):
    if obj.type=='MESH':
        for p in obj.data.polygons: p.use_smooth=True
    return obj

def lathe(name, profile, material, segments=64):
    # profile: list of (r,z) bottom to top
    verts=[]; faces=[]
    rings=len(profile)
    for (r,z) in profile:
        for i in range(segments):
            a=2*math.pi*i/segments
            verts.append((r*math.cos(a), r*math.sin(a), z))
    for j in range(rings-1):
        for i in range(segments):
            i2=(i+1)%segments
            a=j*segments+i; b=j*segments+i2; c=(j+1)*segments+i2; d=(j+1)*segments+i
            faces.append((a,b,c,d))
    # bottom cap centre
    cb=len(verts); verts.append((0,0,profile[0][1]))
    for i in range(segments):
        i2=(i+1)%segments; faces.append((cb,i2,i))
    ct=len(verts); verts.append((0,0,profile[-1][1]))
    base=(rings-1)*segments
    for i in range(segments):
        i2=(i+1)%segments; faces.append((ct, base+i, base+i2))
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces); me.update()
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); bpy.context.collection.objects.link(ob)
    assign(ob,material); smooth(ob)
    return ob

def cyl(name, loc, radius, depth, material, rot=(0,0,0), verts=48, scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=verts, radius=radius, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob=bpy.context.active_object; ob.name=name; ob.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    assign(ob,material); smooth(ob); return ob

def sphere(name, loc, radius, material, scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=48, ring_count=32, radius=radius, location=loc)
    ob=bpy.context.active_object; ob.name=name; ob.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    assign(ob,material); smooth(ob); return ob

def box(name, loc, scale, material, rot=(0,0,0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob=bpy.context.active_object; ob.name=name; ob.dimensions=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    assign(ob,material); return ob

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, material, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_segments=64, minor_segments=16, major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    ob=bpy.context.active_object; ob.name=name; ob.scale=scale
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    assign(ob,material); smooth(ob); return ob

# ---------- BODY ----------
# black base plate
cyl('BaseBlack', (0,0,0.055), 0.92, 0.11, BLK, scale=(1,0.98,1))
cyl('BaseBlackTop', (0,0,0.115), 0.88, 0.04, BLK)

body_profile=[(0.86,0.10),(0.90,0.16),(0.905,0.28),(0.89,0.50),(0.845,0.75),(0.805,0.98),(0.79,1.10),(0.80,1.16),(0.78,1.18)]
lathe('Body', body_profile, YEL)

# black gap ring between body and head
cyl('NeckGap', (0,0,1.195), 0.785, 0.045, BLK)

head_profile=[(0.77,1.20),(0.82,1.24),(0.845,1.35),(0.845,1.62),(0.835,1.76),(0.81,1.83),(0.75,1.875),(0.62,1.895),(0.0,1.90)]
# lathe with r=0 top would create degenerate ring; handle by using min r
head_profile2=[(0.77,1.20),(0.82,1.24),(0.845,1.35),(0.845,1.62),(0.835,1.76),(0.81,1.83),(0.75,1.875),(0.66,1.895)]
lathe('Head', head_profile2, YEL)

# black top disc (slightly inset, domed flat)
cyl('TopDisc', (0,0,1.902), 0.71, 0.035, BLK, verts=64)
# thin rim highlight under disc
torus('TopDiscRim', (0,0,1.895), 0.70, 0.012, BLK2)

# ---------- FEET ----------
def make_foot(side):
    # side -1 left(viewer), +1 right
    x=0.72*side
    # black sole first (slightly wider, flattened teardrop)
    for is_sole in (True, False):
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=48, ring_count=32, radius=1.0, location=(x,-0.58, 0.10 if is_sole else 0.19))
        ob=bpy.context.active_object
        ob.name='FootSole' if is_sole else 'Foot'
        # shape vertices manually in local space (radius 1 sphere)
        for v in ob.data.vertices:
            co=v.co
            # taper toward toe (-Y): narrower and lower at front tip
            taper = 1.0 + co.y*0.38   # y=-1 ->0.62, y=+1->1.38 (but poles are 0 anyway)
            # height profile: taller at heel (+Y back), lower at toe
            hfactor = 1.0 + co.y*0.22
            co.x *= 0.34*taper*(1.06 if is_sole else 1.0)
            co.y *= 0.62*(1.03 if is_sole else 1.0)
            co.z *= (0.09 if is_sole else 0.24)*hfactor
            # flatten bottom
            if not is_sole and co.z < -0.10:
                co.z = -0.10 - (abs(co.z)-0.10)*0.25
            v.co=co
        ob.data.update()
        assign(ob, BLK if is_sole else YEL); smooth(ob)
    # two groove lines across top near heel: thin dark bands wrapping foot
    for gi, gy in enumerate((-0.18,-0.26)):
        t=torus(f'FootGroove{side}_{gi}', (x, gy, 0.20), 0.30, 0.012, YEL2, rot=(0,0,0), scale=(1.0,0.35,0.85))
        # torus default in XY plane; we need band across foot (around Y axis) -> rotate 90 about X
        t.rotation_euler=(math.radians(90),0,0)
        t.scale=(1.05,0.85,0.35)
        bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
        # push slightly into foot so only top arc shows as groove line - keep as subtle inset ring
        t.scale=(0.96,0.96,0.96)

make_foot(-1); make_foot(1)

# ---------- SHOULDERS ----------
for side in (-1,1):
    cyl('ShoulderHub', (0.86*side,0,1.02), 0.265, 0.38, YEL, rot=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    cyl('ShoulderCap', (1.04*side,0,1.02), 0.27, 0.05, YEL, rot=(0,math.radians(90),0))
    sphere('ShoulderCapRound', (1.06*side,0,1.02), 0.27, YEL, scale=(0.18,1,1))

# ---------- EYES ----------
def make_eye(x):
    z=1.60; y=-0.775
    # dark socket disc
    cyl('EyeSocket', (x,y+0.045,z), 0.205, 0.06, BLK2, rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    # rim torus
    torus('EyeRim', (x,y-0.015,z), 0.195, 0.028, RIM, rot=(math.radians(90),0,0))
    # white eyeball recessed
    sphere('Eyeball', (x,y+0.02,z-0.01), 0.175, EYEW, scale=(1,0.62,1))
    # black pupil at bottom front (looking down) - flattened sphere intersecting white
    sphere('Pupil', (x,y-0.055,z-0.115), 0.105, PUP, scale=(1.15,0.45,0.65))
make_eye(-0.325); make_eye(0.325)

# tiny white teeth/pegs in neck gap front centre
for dx in (-0.055,0.055):
    cyl('Tooth', (dx,-0.73,1.19), 0.028, 0.07, WHT, rot=(math.radians(10),0,0), verts=16)

# coin slot on back of head (small black horizontal slot)
box('CoinSlotBack', (0,0.835,1.42), (0.18,0.03,0.035), BLK)
